# opnsense_dnsmasq_boot (Data Source)

Dnsmasq network boot entries (**Services ▸ Dnsmasq DNS & DHCP ▸ DHCP boot**) point PXE clients at a boot file and TFTP server.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the dnsmasq boot entry.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `filename` (String) Boot file name, e.g. `pxelinux.0`.
- `interface` (String) Only apply on this interface.
- `server_address` (String) Address of the TFTP server.
- `server_name` (String) Name of the boot server.
- `tags` (Set of String) UUIDs of tags a client must carry, e.g. one matching the client architecture.
